teaser: Three coffee cups go cold on the side table in a hospital waiting room before you pick which one was ever yours. Life path 7 and the ESFP letters are not an obvious match, and that is the point of this crossing. The 7 asks for long stretches alone with a question nobody else is asking; ESFP takes in a room before it opens a book, lights up whoever is nearest, and feels most like itself when there is an audience. Put the two in one person and you get someone who can hold a room and then needs, badly, to leave it. The tension between the two shows up less in words than in timing, in how fast the leaving happens, and how it gets explained afterward.
